children: RNS Number : 8401E  National Grid PLC  26 November 2026
National Grid plc ('National Grid' or the 'Company')
National Grid today announces the scrip dividend reference price for the 2026/27 interim dividend. A timetable is provided below.

For ordinary shareholders, the scrip dividend reference price for the 2026/27 interim dividend is 1,235.80 pence. This is calculated as the average closing mid-market price of an ordinary share for the five dealing days commencing with, and including, the ordinary share ex-dividend date.

For American Depositary Receipt (‘ADR’) holders, the scrip ADR reference price for the 2026/27 interim dividend is US$80.8646. This is calculated by multiplying the scrip dividend reference price above by five (as there are five ordinary shares underlying each ADR) and by the average US$ rate for the equivalent dates.
The terms and conditions of the Scrip Dividend Scheme are available on the Investors section of the Company's website and from Equiniti (0800 169 7775).
2026/27 half-year results and interim dividend amount declared – 16.97 pence per ordinary share; $1.1433 per ADR*
Scrip election date for 2026/27 interim dividend – ADRs
Scrip election date for 2026/27 interim dividend – ordinary shares
2026/27 interim dividend paid to qualifying shareholders

*The figure shown is gross of a $0.01 per ADR interim dividend fee which will be applied to cash distributions made to ADR holders in relation to the 2026/27 interim dividend. This fee does not apply to ADRs received through the scrip dividend.
